sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "articles"."authref" AS e, "users"."substatus" AS g, AVG(("articles"."accscore" - "articles"."sentscore")) AS m1 FROM "articles" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "articles"."authref"  GROUP BY "articles"."authref", "users"."substatus"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: accessibility score - sentiment score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same article
average of accessibility score minus sentiment score per users within users.substatus
gap to the all average of average of accessibility score minus sentiment score (all level)
rank within the group by average of accessibility score minus sentiment score, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sessions"."userel" AS e, "users"."testgrp" AS g, AVG((CAST("sessions"."engscore" AS REAL) / "sessions"."seshviews")) AS m1 FROM "sessions" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "sessions"."userel"  GROUP BY "sessions"."userel", "users"."testgrp"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
quantities: sessions.session engagement score per pages viewed
why: session engagement score / pages viewed: the catalogue declares session engagement score part of pages viewed
average of session engagement score per pages viewed per users within users.testgrp
gap to the all average of average of session engagement score per pages viewed (all level)
rank within the group by average of session engagement score per pages viewed, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "systemperformance"."devlink" AS e, "users"."seglabel" AS g, AVG(("systemperformance"."loadscore" - "systemperformance"."perfscore")) AS m1 FROM "systemperformance" JOIN "devices" ON "devices"."devkey" = "systemperformance"."devlink" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "devices"."uselink" GROUP BY "systemperformance"."devlink", "users"."seglabel"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
quantities: systemperformance.system load score minus system performance score
why: system load score - system performance score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same performance log record
average of system load score minus system performance score per devices within users.seglabel
gap to the all average of average of system load score minus system performance score (all level)
rank within the group by average of system load score minus system performance score, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "systemperformance"."devlink" AS e, "users"."gendlbl" AS g, AVG(("systemperformance"."loadscore" - "systemperformance"."perfscore")) AS m1 FROM "systemperformance" JOIN "devices" ON "devices"."devkey" = "systemperformance"."devlink" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "devices"."uselink" GROUP BY "systemperformance"."devlink", "users"."gendlbl"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
quantities: systemperformance.system load score minus system performance score
why: system load score - system performance score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same performance log record
average of system load score minus system performance score per devices within users.gendlbl
gap to the g average of average of system load score minus system performance score (g level)
rank within the group by average of system load score minus system performance score: gap to the g average, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sessions"."userel" AS e, "users"."substatus" AS g, AVG((CAST("sessions"."bncrate" AS REAL) / "sessions"."seshdepth")) AS m1 FROM "sessions" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "sessions"."userel"  GROUP BY "sessions"."userel", "users"."substatus"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: bounce rate / navigation depth: the catalogue declares bounce rate part of navigation depth
average of bounce rate per navigation depth per users within users.substatus
index against the g average of average of bounce rate per navigation depth (g level)
rank within the group by average of bounce rate per navigation depth, keep the top 3
